notes.title: New Content & Changes
notes.notes:
Howdy!

I have re-added the revolution unit changes that was in the polls so long ago! It's been missing so the change is now applied. For those who forgot what that change was: Inspires his units to immediately respawn when he is knocked out. Gives 10% attack bonus to all allied units. whereas it used to only affect certain units now it is all units!

I have also begun the major changes to Forest Guardians that I think will enhance the ranked gameplay. We now have new difficulty settings for Forest Guardians for the logging bots and settings in game that will vary depending on the setting you chose. Each Forest Guardian difficulty has it's own rank classifications too for ranked matches.

The difficulties are as follows: Level 1 (Low) 

AI Skill: Low,

Behavior: Simple, predictable patterns,

Spawn Rate: Base rate for normal robots but less supers,

Strategy: Basic movement toward nearest targets,

 Level 2 (Medium) 

AI Skill: Medium,

Behavior: Balanced approach with some randomness,

Spawn Rate: 15% faster than base,

Strategy: Occasional sub-optimal choices (30% random movement),

 Level 3 (High) 

AI Skill: High,

Behavior: Advanced tactics and coordination,

Spawn Rate: 15% faster than base,

Strategy: Strategic targeting, prioritizes units near trees,

 Level 4 (Very High) 

AI Skill: Very High,

Behavior: Highly strategic with coordination,

Spawn Rate: 30% faster than base,

Strategy: Avoids clustering, analyzes damage ratios, optimal positioning


We also now have a guide on our Discord on how to make and test your very own maps and even share and play them together too! Check out our Discord for details on that.

notes.title: 🔥 MAJOR UPDATE NOW LIVE! – April 2025 🔥
notes.notes:
Howdy, cowpokes! We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes and we’re thrilled to bring you a major update for Bang! Howdy. This release packs a punch with huge improvements to stability, compatibility, and security. Here's what's new:


🛡️ Revamped Anti-Cheat System 

We’ve overhauled our anti-cheat to make sure everyone plays fair. This new system helps us detect and prevent cheating more effectively than ever.

💻 Expanded Platform Support 
Bang! Howdy now supports:

 Windows
 macOS (including ARM & AARCH64)

So no matter what machine you’re on, you can now jump into the action!

🏙️ Boom Town Provisional Assets
We're getting closer to the full Boom Town release! With this update, you’ll see provisional assets in place while development continues.

🧯 Fixed Major Crash on Launch
We’ve resolved a critical issue where the game would crash on start if you had previously logged into Boom Town in Beta from the Production client. This fix should significantly improve overall launch stability.

🎮 Steam Launch Requirement
The game must now be launched through Steam. This is part of our effort to ensure account integrity and better support for cross-platform stability.

🆔 Steam ID Verification
Your Steam ID is now sent to our servers for secure verification. This helps us monitor usage and prevent abuse.

🚫 Virtual Machine Support Disabled
As part of our anti-exploit measures, the game can no longer be run inside virtual machines. This helps us ensure fair play for all players.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback as we work toward making Bang! Howdy the best it can be. Ride on, and stay tuned for more updates soon!

🤠 – The Affliction Studios Team

notes.title: Major Update & Free Trial To ALL!
notes.notes:
The time has come.. The major update is being rolled out to live/production.

Fixed login for passwords WITH characters
Fixed Pardner Adding Bug
Fixed Errors in Demented Bob bounty for some folks (It was broken for some but not all due to an error)
Added Fork Lift Unit (ITP): - Fling your enemies across the map by attacking them with this unit
Added Blown Gasket Card (ITP) - Affected Steam unit can move 6 tiles; then cannot move
Added Buggy Logic Card (ITP) - Opponent's steam unit is controlled for one turn
Added Dust Devil Card (ITP) - Resurrects dead steam unit
Added Monkey Wrench Card (ITP) - Damages steam unit for every tile they move
Added Atomic Card (ITP) - Wipe the floor with your enemies and maybe yerself too if you're not careful
Lots of new maps added to ITP map rotations (Currently about 20 new maps)
Holding Backspace now works!
You can now paste (ctrl + v) in any input for example for passwords.


All players will be given a one time 7 day trial, so everyone can freely test out the new content. We also will be posting more information thru Steam instead of just Discord from this point forward. We apologize for the lack of updates thru Steam, we have heard your complaints and are listening.

You can also join our Discord thru https://banghowdy.com and click the Help button to be directed to our Discord.

notes.title: Some Upcoming Changes
notes.notes:
To further continue Bang! Howdy.. We have decided to migrate from free to play to paid to play by removing all micro-transactions and making the game a paid product.

This was done in order so we can continue the Bang! Howdy series and keep it up and running. You will be able to play Free to Play until Steam updates the game for us.

An update has been pushed that fixes a ton of issues that we had in our previous line. More information will be released shortly.

For up-to-date information visit our Discord at: http://discord.gg/yourfunworldstudios

notes.title: Major Update Released
notes.notes:
We have revamped Bang! Howdy! For starts we will be re-balancing some things including scores to make it a bit more fair and balanced. Some things being worked on: 

- Lower Cowpoke badge to 25 games played. 50 games is a lot of games in an essentially limited variety of opponents. Players likely encounter the same opponents often and that could be discouraging. Lowering this requirement would allow for more gang competition as more gangs spring into the ranks.

- This would be a big change - add the ability to buy the exchange pass for a lot of scrip, talking like 10-12.5k scrip, in league of lower end Familar duds. Removes the monetary boundary, new players to free to play games are often young and don't have access to payment options.(edited)
This may have been done already, but removing the Coin requirement for ITP ticket would help too

- Introduction of Casual Games.. You must have played at least 50 games before you will be able to play Ranked games. These games can include Tutorials, Bounties, and casual games.

- Bug fixes

- Working on adding support for Bang! Howdy Mobile Edition (More detailed information on will be posted soon or join our Discord at http://discord.gg/yourfunworldstudios)

notes.title: Major Update Scheduled on 12/22/2017
notes.notes:
We will be pushing our major update on 12/22/2017 at 12PM EST.

We're in the works of revamping Bang! Howdy! For starts we will be re-balancing some things including scores to make it a bit more fair and ballanced. Some things being worked on: 

- Change the default "Bang! Howdy" parlor into an unranked game table
- Allow use of all units (locked or unlocked) in unranked table games. 
These changes will encourage new players to play unranked and get a feel for the units and deeper strategy of the game.

For Forest Guardians:
- I don't know how deeply embedded this would be in the "legacy" code, but if we can modify the percentiles for ranks to account for a smaller playerbase, that could help.

- Lower Cowpoke badge to 25 games played. 50 games is a lot of games in an essentially limited variety of opponents. Players likely encounter the same opponents often and that could be discouraging. Lowering this requirement would allow for more gang competition as more gangs spring into the ranks.

- Bring back gang rentals. This was a popular aspect of the game in its prime. Potential Coin and scrip sink. Avoid adding Coin reqs to the Buckle items, though, that was too much.

- This would be a big change - add the ability to buy the exchange pass for a lot of scrip, talking like 10-12.5k scrip, in league of lower end Familar duds. Removes the monetary boundary, new players to free to play games are often young and don't have access to payment options.(edited)
This may have been done already, but removing the Coin requirement for ITP ticket would help too

- Bug fixes

- Working on adding support for Bang! Howdy Mobile Edition (More detailed information on will be posted soon or join our Discord at http://discord.gg/yourfunworldstudios)


A much more comprehensive stats menu when you open up someone's Wanted Poster including specific statistics on games.

The ability to gift coins & scrip to people is currently being looked into but NOT promised.
